# Preface {.unnumbered}

This book teaches the [Nim](https://nim-lang.org) programming language in English, for readers who
have written code in another language (Python, JavaScript, PHP, or Go) but have never used a
language that compiles to native code.

It is **not** a translation of the official documentation. The official docs are complete and
actively maintained; this book is a companion, not a replacement. If you are comfortable with
systems programming jargon, start with the
[official documentation](https://nim-lang.org/documentation.html) instead.

## Who this book is for

The book covers what is different about Nim, not the basics of programming. Readers are expected to
know variables, loops, functions, and errors. If those ideas are new, finish an introduction to
another language first, then come back. This is not a first course in programming; it speeds up a
reader who already has the basics, rather than building them from scratch.

## Before you start

All you need is your own computer. The setup guide is in
[Installing Nim](chapters/installation.qmd), and it only has to be run once. Once `nim` is
available, every example in the book runs directly in the terminal. For the exercises, a plain
text editor is enough; there is no framework or extra tool to install.

This is not a pile of untested snippets. Every example lives under `examples/`, is compiled, and
its output is compared automatically. Some examples fail on purpose, so you learn to read compiler
messages from the first chapter.

## How to read

If this is your first time with Nim, read in order. If you have used a similar language before,
start at [Variables](chapters/variables.qmd) and jump around as needed. Each chapter opens with a
real problem and closes with exercises and a short summary.

The book has three parts. Part A covers the syntax and types used every day. Part B moves into
modules, exceptions, generics, and memory. Part C builds real programs: a CLI, an HTTP API, a
database, and a published package. Each chapter stands on its own, but the examples in the later
chapters reuse material from earlier ones.

Every chapter ends with exercises, and the answers are in [Appendix A](appendix/answers.qmd). Those
answers are not the only correct ones, just the most direct.

## Download and other editions

The book is available as a [PDF](https://nim.qouver.com/en/Learning-Nim.pdf) for reading offline,
and in the [Indonesian edition](https://nim.qouver.com/). Source and issue tracker live at
[github.com/nferdazel/nim-id](https://github.com/nferdazel/nim-id).
